subject: detection probability plot in heterogeneity model

messages.author: 4140d98df209a83d
messages.subject: detection probability plot in heterogeneity model
parts:
Dears,

When I fit the heterogeneity model

mh2 <-secr.fit(ocelot.4temp, model=list(D~Ambiente, g0 ~ h2, sigma ~ h2), mask = HabitatMask2, trace=FALSE)


and plot the detection probability

plot (mh2, limits= TRUE, xval = 0:6000, ylim = c(0, 0.004))

The plot returns two curves. What does this two curves mean?

Regards

messages.author: 58a62321f08f30f8
messages.subject: Re: detection probability plot in heterogeneity model
parts:
Hi Christiano,

If you think about why you fit the 'h2' model, and what that model means/does, i think the fact you have two curves will become clear. If not, check back in.

Chris
